name: subscribe__wildcard_against_real_topology
description: Drives the IM:Subscribe negotiation with an all-wildcard AttributePath (HasEndpoint=HasCluster=HasAttribute=false) against the single_onoff_endpoint_source topology. The dispatcher's wildcard-expansion path produces one AttributeReport per (endpoint × cluster × attribute) match — exercising the cross-endpoint enumeration logic that hides behind every Apple-side initial Subscribe. The scenario asserts the negotiation completes with an initial ReportData → per-chunk StatusResponse → SubscribeResponse. Multi-chunk burst variants (one MoreChunkedMessages=true intermediate, one MoreChunkedMessages=false final) stay queued behind a larger topology recipe that overflows the 1100-byte chunk budget.
